title: Bodycam: Deputies Kick ‘Crazy B*tch’ Out of Florida Bar
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida deputies trespassing a woman from a bar after the owner, who called her a “crazy b*tch,” asked law enforcement to ban her from the establishment on May 19. Authorities said Summer Yoder, a member of a prominent family in Sumter County, was found to be “highly intoxicated” when they arrived. Yoder was asked to leave the Dallas Inn bar more than 15 times. When deputies asked her to leave, she refused and headed back into the bar — that’s when things escalated quickly. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
